Name: Early Community Upgrades
Author: sophiesalacia
Description:
[center][b][size=5][color=#ff0000][size=5]This mod is no longer maintained. I am currently working on a mod that will replace it completely.[/size][/color]


Early Community Upgrades[/size][/b][/center][center][i]by Vertigon[/i][/center]

This mod allows the player to decide when they are ready to purchase the Community Upgrades from Robin, and how much they should cost.

Choose from a list of presets (if you have GMCM installed), or set your own values in the included config file.

This mod has not been heavily tested, especially in regards to multiplayer, so if you run into any issues please report them!

Localized for all languages that Stardew has native support for.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Alternatively, if you are using a mod manager, download using your mod manager of choice (I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/6194]Mod Organizer 2[/url] with the [url=https://github.com/ModOrganizer2/modorganizer-basic_games]Simple Games Plugin[/url]).

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], you can simply launch the game and edit the parameters from within GMCM. There is no need to reload the game for changes to take effect. If you do not see the value you want in the drop-down menu, you can edit the value yourself (see non-GMCM instructions below).

If you are not using Generic Mod Config Menu, you will need to launch the game to generate the config.json file, which you can then edit. You will need to reload the game for changes to take effect. The parameters are as follows:

﻿
[size=4]Order[/size]
[list][quote][*][font=Courier New]shortcutsFirst[/font]: If enabled, Robin will offer map shortcuts before offering to upgrade Pam's house.
[/quote][/list] ﻿[size=4]Costs[/size]
[list]
[quote][*][font=Courier New]pamCostGold[/font]: How much gold Robin charges to build Pam's new house.
[*][font=Courier New]pamCostWood[/font]: How much wood Robin needs to build Pam's new house.
[*][font=Courier New]shortcutCostGold[/font]: How much gold Robin charges to create the shortcuts.
[/quote][/list] ﻿[size=4]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[quote][*][font=Courier New]numFarmhouseUpgrades[/font]: How many times the farmhouse needs to have been upgraded for Robin to offer the community upgrades. Starts at 0, maximum of 3, default is 3.
[*][font=Courier New]numRoomsCompleted[/font]: How many rooms of the Community Center or Joja Warehouse need to have been completed for Robin to offer the community upgrades. Starts at 0, maximum of 6, default is 6.
[*][font=Courier New]numFriendshipHeartsGained[/font]: How many total hearts the player needs to have with the townspeople for Robin to offer the community upgrades. ﻿Starts at 0, maximum of 320, default is 0.
[/quote][/list] [size=4]Time[/size]
[list][quote][*][font=Courier New]daysUntilCommunityUpgrade[/font]: Number of days before community upgrade is completed.
[/quote][/list] [size=4]Instant Unlocks[/size]
[list][quote][*][font=Courier New]pamsHouse[/font]: If enabled, Pam's house will be upgraded from the start.
[*][font=Courier New]shortcuts[/font]: If enabled, shortcuts will be accessible from the start.
[/quote][/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Windows. Linux/Mac have not been tested, but should work. Earlier game versions have not been tested, but should work. Please report any issues you encounter.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer. Again, multiplayer has not been extensively tested, so please report any issues you encounter.
[*]Not guaranteed to work with any mods which alter Robin's Carpenter menu dialog.
[/list]
